prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training - high-endurance performance with carbohydrate loading and pre/post-workout nutrition timing

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers full 24-hour period with 4-5 meals/snacks
Total daily calories and carbohydrate content support marathon training demands (minimum 3000 kcal, 60% carbs)
Includes pre-workout, during-workout (if applicable), and post-workout nutrition with appropriate timing
All meals respect vegetarian and nut-free restrictions
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single Athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high calorie intake and carbohydrate loading with specific timing around training sessions

prompt_inputs.goal: Maximize muscle recovery and strength gains from resistance training

solution_criteria: Meal plan includes 4-5 meals distributed throughout the day with strategic timing around training
Total daily protein intake meets or exceeds 1.6g per kg of body weight (136g minimum)
Pre-training and post-training meals are specifically identified with appropriate macronutrient composition
Plan is compact and concise (fits within 1 page format)
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single Athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) needing protein-focused meals and strategic meal timing around resistance training with emphasis on muscle recovery

prompt_inputs.goal: Optimize performance and recovery for soccer match and training

solution_criteria: Includes 4-6 meals/snacks with balanced macronutrients (carbs for aerobic/anaerobic demands, protein for recovery, healthy fats)
Provides specific hydration guidelines with timing and volume recommendations
All meals align with vegetarian and dairy-free restrictions
Meal plan is compact and concise (fits within 1 page format)
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single Athlete
scenario: Testing with a sport-specific athlete (soccer player) requiring balanced macronutrients, hydration guidelines, and meals that support both aerobic and anaerobic performance demands
